verdict.rationale: There is no export feature, but the product writes all its working state as local files in a `replica/` folder inside your own project, and design tokens are kept as `tokens.json`. Its helper scripts are standard-library Python that never touch the network, so the data effectively stays in your repo and you can leave. Missing for 10: an explicit documented export or data-portability statement, confirmation that every artifact uses an open format (only tokens.json is shown), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Each one reads what the last one wrote, in a `replica/` folder in your project.
Six of them, all standard-library Python. None touch the network.
